module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_control_regfile
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Compact FPGA-friendly register window with synchronous decode and stateful configuration flops; no bulk geometry or tensor storage.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Decode software writes into stable configuration and control strobes; expose status and latest command snapshot for readback; use explicit status-clear and issue-request controls.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Store only scalar configuration, metadata tokens, and telemetry-related controls in flops; geometry remains an external descriptor/token rather than an on-chip model.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive configuration outputs, read data, issue/status strobes, and metadata descriptors used by downstream request packaging and safety logic.
ownership_notes: Owns the software-visible control-plane state for enable, soft reset, pipelined mode, sequence seed, timeout thresholds, actuator bounds, fallback command, stream velocity, flow-condition metadata, geometry metadata, status clear, and issue-request strobes.
Readback is limited to compact register-window data and command/status snapshots; no tensor, mesh, or flow-field content is stored or exposed.

module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_request_packager
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Fixed-width transport composer that concatenates control metadata into a 128-bit request word.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Launch a request only when enabled, explicitly issued, and not blocked by outstanding inflight state in default single-transaction mode; hold payload stable until handshake acceptance.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Maintain only request-launch hold, transaction/sequence bookkeeping, and inflight control; no deep buffering or payload memory.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Present req_data and req_valid as a bounded valid/ready stream toward the external worker; keep the packet stable while req_valid is asserted and req_ready is low.
ownership_notes: Owns outbound request composition and launch arbitration.
Carries transaction ID, sequence counter, configuration snapshot, flow-condition fields, and a compact geometry token/descriptor only; it does not interpret geometry or compute physics.

module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_response_validator
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Lightweight inbound checker with identity, freshness, and enable/model gating; accepts only matching responses.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Compare response transaction ID and sequence against the outstanding request, then apply watchdog timeout and response-age checks before allowing acceptance.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Retain only minimal control-oriented watchdog/acceptance context; do not buffer full responses beyond what is needed to qualify acceptance.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Assert acceptance and forward accepted_model_data only for valid, matching, non-stale responses; otherwise raise validation, stale, or timeout indicators and keep the safe path unchanged.
ownership_notes: Owns response qualification, rejection, and acceptance indicators.
Acts only as a gate for model-present/model-enabled and freshness constraints; it does not perform model interpretation or physics computation.

module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_command_mapper
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Abstract fixed-width command translator from accepted model output to a 32-bit actuator command word.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Use configuration-driven mapping rules that are agnostic to actuator type and mechanical package; provide a valid mapped command only when a response has been accepted.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Keep mapping state minimal and synchronous; no geometry, tensor, or surrogate computation state is retained.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Produce mapped_cmd and mapped_cmd_valid for downstream safety gating; the command encoding is left to software/integration definition.
ownership_notes: Owns the abstract translation from accepted model output fields to a deterministic 32-bit command word.
Does not hardcode spoiler/flap/grille/diffuser semantics beyond software-defined encoding.

module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_safety_gate
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Final bounded-output authority that clamps commands, applies fallback policy, and aggregates telemetry.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Select fallback whenever validation fails, timeout occurs, enable is deasserted, or stale data is detected; otherwise pass the mapped command through min/max saturation logic.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Hold only status and fallback/saturation latches needed for software-visible telemetry and deterministic safe behavior; reset returns to fallback-active state.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive act_cmd, act_cmd_valid, and a 32-bit status word; clamp to configured bounds before output and assert saturation when limiting occurs.
ownership_notes: Owns the final actuator command validity and safety policy.
Publishes busy, ready-for-request, response-pending, response-accepted, validation-failed, stale-rejected, timeout, saturation, fallback-active, and enable status bits.

consistency_notes: No hierarchy, ports, or filenames may differ from digital_spec_json.
